color.note: Direction: Black Tie (owner approved 2026-11-01). Black, bone and champagne; rani pink once per screen as a solid fill, on the main action, plus the O in the logo; anything the visitor hovers, chooses or completes lights up pink (lit tokens, BT8). Dark everywhere: the landing page and the tools share one palette. Print is black on white. Token names are kept from Pre-Party so every page keeps working; their roles are described in usage.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, product rows, form panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, hovered cards, skeleton bones, notices.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and the edge of sheets and dialogs (there are no shadows). Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, steppers, unselected chips and choice cards, secondary buttons. 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Bone. Body and headings.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary facts (ml, brand, helper text).

tokens.name: detail
tokens.usage: Champagne. Eyebrow labels, step numbers, small details. Never body copy.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Rani pink. The primary button fill, once per screen.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Black, never white.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Pink links and ghost buttons where a link must stand out. Use sparingly; plain links are bone and underlined.

tokens.name: lit
tokens.usage: Lit states (BT8): the pink edge of anything hovered, focused or chosen, and progress fills. A line or bar, never a solid control fill (that stays the one main action).

tokens.name: lit-bg
tokens.usage: Lit states (BT8): dark pink fill of a chosen chip, answer, ticked ingredient or open panel. Text on it is text or lit-text.

tokens.name: lit-text
tokens.usage: Lit states (BT8): the label of a chosen chip or the current step.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Bone fill for selected chips, the current stage, the stepper once a product is added.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on highlight.

tokens.name: highlight-quiet
tokens.usage: Selected choice-card fill. Text on it stays text.

tokens.name: city
tokens.usage: The For venues band: bone with black text. The Pre-Party pink nod is gone.

tokens.name: on-city
tokens.usage: Text on a city fill.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: The plan summary bar and cook-mode chrome.

tokens.name: on-bar
tokens.usage: Text on bar.

tokens.name: on-bar-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bar.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Within budget, You're on the list, Ready to make. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Guests changed, Pack size changed, One ingredient away. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Field errors, Over budget, Temporarily unavailable. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring outside a 2px bg gap, on every interactive element.

type.note: The Archivo file is pinned to its widest width (wdth 125) and weights 700-800, so every use of --font-display is wide. Display styles are set in capitals.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Mobile hero; tool titles on desktop.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Section titles, tool titles on mobile, recipe names.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Book clubs and tables in Jaipur, then walk in with a pass.
styles.usage: The one line under the hero; cook-mode steps (22px there).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Alcohol only. Mixers and food aren't included.
styles.usage: Default copy. Never smaller in the tools.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Meta and helper text. Never for anything needed to continue.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Stock photo, not a Socifer venue
styles.usage: Photo credit, price-checked date, legal lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, stepper parts, inline meta.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside cards, title to meta.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards and form fields; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

radius.note: Square corners everywhere. The names stay so existing styles keep resolving.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, thumbnails, skeleton bones.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, steppers, choice cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, colour blocks, the pass.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the stage bar. Square too.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every control.

tokens.name: target-primary
tokens.usage: Primary actions and full-width mobile buttons.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Landing content width at 1440.

tokens.name: tool-max
tokens.usage: Tool content width.

tokens.name: summary-bar-h
tokens.usage: Plan summary bar on mobile; reserve as bottom padding.

shadow.note: No shadows. Sheets and dialogs get a 1px line edge instead.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the summary bar: a hairline on the top edge.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Centred dialogs: a hairline all round.
